notes.title: Nominate Captain Firehawk for the Steam Awards!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

First of all, Happy Thanksgiving! We’d like to thank our community for the support. This is our first game, and it’s very special to us (Lexy & Roxy). We created this game with all our love, effort, and dedication. It seems we’ve met the expectations of some and not of others, but one thing is certain: our game is unique, and we’re proud of that! We’d love it if you could nominate us for the [b]Outstanding Visual Style[/b] category in the Steam Awards!

Thank you so much! We are still very small and if you like us, please spread the word!

notes.title: SERVICE PACK DEPLOYMENT - 1.3
notes.notes:
This is a smaller update in terms of sheer patch note line items- but a pretty substantial one in terms of actual changes to how the game plays and feels. We've been working hard on this one in order to take the feedback we got from the initial launch of the game and fix some of the most commonly recurring complaints we've been hearing in regards to gameplay.

[h2]Improved path system:[/h2]
A smarter path system will make the boss battles more dynamic. No more waiting around for the camera to cycle to parts of clothing you haven't stripped off- the camera will automatically move and focus on the parts of the giantess that are the most relevant.

[h2]Blinks and color corrections:[/h2]
The blink system has been adjusted for greater comfort.

[h2]Additional bug fixes:[/h2]
Cleaned up additional smaller things that have been reported or that we've run into.

Exit: Hold Start or Esc or Start[/b]

notes.title: Captain Firehawk and the Laser Love Situation is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42864193/be71478e5fde93377473a665645102f907a7c547.gif[/img]

The folks at Portland Caviar have been hard at work, and we are proud to finally announce that [b]Captain Firehawk and the Laser Love Situation is Now Available on Steam![/b]

We first introduced Captain Firehawk on Kickstarter- and thanks to the support from the community, we were able to get the funding required to bring the game to life. Now we are excited to show the finished game!

What's more, it is the first game on the TinyHat Label which provides multiple language support right out of the gate! [b]Currently the game has full localization for Brazillian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.[/b] We are also working on French and Spanish localization which we hope to add to the game at some point in the future. We hope to offer additional language support to future games we launch on the label, and are actively working on adding some additional localization to existing games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42864193/69949f3ff33b9964a24dd0d3b20c75bb0883ea62.png[/img]

If you are interested in Captain Firehawk, now is the time to pick it up, as [b]it is currently 10% off during launch week![/b] It's a limited time deal, so pick it up while you can!

What's more is there is a label-wide sale happening on the TinyHat label- the [b]TinyHat Lunar Love Sale[/b]. This week only, most games on the label are discounted! So pick up Captain Firehawk, and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/tinyhat-studios]check out what other awesome adult games are available![/url]
